title: Elaboration of Non-naturally Occurring Helical Tripeptides as p53-MDM2/MDMX Interaction Inhibitors.
authors: Su, Aoze; Tabata, Yuko; Aoki, Kiyono; Sada, Akane; Ohki, Rieko; Nagatoishi, Satoru; Tsumoto, Kouhei; Wang, Siyuan; Otani, Yuko; Ohwada, Tomohiko
one_liner_zh: 该文研究非天然螺旋三肽抑制p53-MDM2/MDMX蛋白-蛋白相互作用，虽用对接和MD方法，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) are often mediated by helical, strand and/or coil secondary structures at the interface regions. We previously showed that non-naturally occurring, stable helical trimers of bicyclic beta-amino acids (Abh) with all-trans amide bonds can block the p53-MDM2/MDMX alpha-helix-helix interaction, which plays a role in regulating p53 function. Here, we conducted docking and molecular dynamics calculations to guide the structural optimization of our reported compounds, focusing on modifications of the C-terminal/N-terminal residues. We confirmed that the modified peptides directly bind to MDM2 by means of thermal shift assay, isothermal titration calorimetry, and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) experiments. Biological activity assay in human osteosarcoma cell line SJSA-1, which has wild-type p53 and amplification of the Mdm2 gene, indicated that these peptides are membrane-permeable p53-MDM2/MDMX interaction antagonists that can rescue p53 function in the cells.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）通常由界面区域的螺旋、链状和/或卷曲二级结构介导。我们先前的研究表明，由双环β-氨基酸（Abh）构成的全反式酰胺键稳定非天然螺旋三聚体，能够阻断p53-MDM2/MDMX α-螺旋-螺旋相互作用，该相互作用在调节p53功能中发挥作用。在此，我们进行了对接和分子动力学计算，以指导我们已报道化合物的结构优化，重点聚焦于C端/N端残基的修饰。我们通过热位移分析、等温滴定量热法和酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）实验确认，修饰后的肽能直接结合MDM2。在人骨肉瘤细胞系SJSA-1（该细胞系具有野生型p53和Mdm2基因扩增）中的生物活性测定表明，这些肽是膜通透性的p53-MDM2/MDMX相互作用拮抗剂，能够在细胞内恢复p53功能。
